name: Holo Card
hint: Move across the card, or Tab to it and use the arrow keys. Press it.
description: Collectible / membership card with pointer- and keyboard-driven 3D tilt. Sunburst foil, glitter and a tight glare are separate materials that follow the light at different rates over the art.
usage: Use as a hero object: membership tiers, launch passes, digital collectibles, referral rewards, or a 'your card' moment in onboarding. One per viewport. Do not use in dense grids. Everything printed is yours: `title`, `holder`, `number` (shown after `numberPrefix`, default "Nº"), `tier` (the pill) and `brand` (top left); each prints only when given. The picture is `artwork` (your node), else `image` (a URL), else the procedural `art`; `children` replace the printed text entirely. Pass `onPress` to make the card a button (click, Enter or Space), e.g. to open the pass; without it the card is one named image (role img, named from title, tier, holder and number, or `label`). `disabled` stops tilt, light and press, dims the card and takes it out of the tab order. `idle` sweeps the light across once each time the card comes into view, then rests (no loop). `forceState` ("hover" | "focus") pins a demo state. Arrow keys tilt it and move the light, Shift for bigger steps, Home or Escape levels it. Vertical swipes on the card scroll the page; presses and sideways drags tilt it. Under reduced motion there is no tilt, sweep or entrance travel; the light still follows pointer and keys. The ref is the card itself (the tab stop). `demo` prints a sample holder, number, tier and brand (gallery only).

example:
<HoloCard
  title="Founding member"
  holder={user.name}
  number={user.memberNo}
  tier="Gold"
  brand="Members ✦"
  image={user.passArt}
  onPress={() => openPass()}
/>
